title: Late debounced save / pagehide beacon re-creates a draft after confirmed erasure (no tombstone guard on INSERT)
detail: Applicant with the form still open in a tab confirms draft erasure; a later step-change save or tab-close beacon upserts fresh PII into a brand-new row (the ON CONFLICT tombstone guard only covers submitted_at, and erasure deletes the row outright). The confirmed Art. 17 deletion is silently undone; the resurrected email+fields persist until vacancy close.
recommended_fix: Make erasure a strip (fields='{}', continue_token=NULL, erased marker) instead of DELETE, and extend the upsert's ON CONFLICT WHERE to skip erased rows — mirroring the submitted_at tombstone pattern already used for strip-on-submit.

title: Clean pagehide beacon from the resume page stamps resumed_at with zero re-engagement
detail: Open-and-close (or a JS-executing mail scanner that fires pagehide) stamps resumed_at via the beacon although the applicant never engaged — the client has no dirty/baseline tracking on the resume render, so the anti-prefetch intent of the re-engagement rule is only partially enforced.
recommended_fix: On the resume render, seed the client's baseline with the restored payload (or set a dirty flag on the first input/step event) and only include resume_token in the payload once real engagement occurred.
